content.contentDesc: Co-engineered DataRobot's build platform using Spring Boot, the sole build layer behind its GenAI platform where custom models, apps, jobs, and execution environments all get built, across 5 registries spanning AWS, GCP, and Azure, plus 4 storage backends. Owned Python build services running on Kubernetes that build & push images using BuildKit & Kaniko, handling 1M+ builds per day. Reduced median build time by 75% by implementing a parameter-based caching layer that reuses artifacts from earlier builds. Led a Java-to-Go migration of the build scheduler with product & tech leads, balancing risk while cutting median build time by 36%. Cut build-failure detection time from hours to real time for 2M+ users by building live log & security-scan streaming with OpenTelemetry. Caught major bugs before release by designing an end-to-end test suite that runs across 7 environments using Python & Harness CI/CD. Saved 50+ engineering hours per week by building a Claude-based AI agent in Python that patches security vulnerabilities & opens PRs. Performed on-call, production debugging & code review duties for the Compute Services organization across 3 regions (US, EU & JP)

Designed 107 Capture the Flag challenges in Python and C++ covering web security, cryptography, and scripting, used across 5 courses. Automated challenge grading by building a custom judging algorithm, replacing manual grading of 1000+ submissions per term. Reduced development cycle time by 15% by setting up Jenkins CI/CD pipelines that automated testing and deployment. Mentored 200 students every semester in office hours, coaching them through solving cybersecurity based Capture the Flag challenges

Built REST APIs using FastAPI & MySQL for payments and transaction processing, serving 100,000+ orders daily at 99.9% availability. Integrated Stripe payments with idempotency keys, ensuring 0 duplicate charges on retried transactions. Improved response times & kept payment processing stable under 10,000+ retries per second by building a sharded Redis cache. Optimized resource utilization by 15% by orchestrating distributed backend services on AWS with Kubernetes and EKS. Slashed mean time to diagnose production incidents by 50% by setting up 6 metrics dashboards & distributed tracing for payment services

Built backend APIs in Python (FastAPI) and Node.js for a supply chain management system, routing orders across 2,600+ SKUs. Achieved 90% backend test coverage by writing an automated test suite with pytest and Selenium, reducing production regressions. Cut post-release defects by 60% by leading code reviews and introducing automated testing and debugging practices

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to build 2 application UIs using React and Redux, boosting user experience. Identified and fixed security vulnerabilities in 6 modules, strengthening overall system security

Built a RAG pipeline with Python, Pinecone, RocksDB & LlamaIndex using meta-chunking strategies that cut inference time by 46% while improving retrieval accuracy. Designed a contextual retrieval pipeline using LLaMA-2-7B-Instruct for descriptive chunk summarization. Implemented meta-chunking with dynamic merging to optimize document segmentation and retrieval.

Designed a serverless pipeline using AWS Lambda to split videos into frames and perform face recognition. Integrated FFmpeg and ResNet-34 CNN for large-scale video processing, segmentation and face detection. Optimized end-to-end processing to handle 100+ videos in under 300 seconds, ensuring high concurrency and low latency.

Architected an elastic cloud application using AWS EC2 & SQS, capable of handling 10,000+ concurrent requests. Orchestrated a REST API for image recognition, utilizing deep learning models & returning results in under 80 ms. Programmed a custom auto-scaling algorithm, slashing down resource costs by 20% during low-traffic periods

Built a real-time pipeline that streams NYC taxi trip events through Kafka into Neo4j, deployed on Kubernetes with Docker. Configured Kafka Connect to stream large datasets into Neo4j for near real-time graph analytics. Ran PageRank and BFS on the live graph for hotspot detection and route optimization

Fabricated smart contracts to record & manage the transfer of evidence custody, ensuring transparent storage. Designed a command-line tool using Python integrated with Web3.js reducing time for evidence retrieval by 40%.

Architected a secure banking application enabling account creation, transfers, and balance management in real-time. Set up Postgres database, created database schemas & optimized queries to achieve faster information retrieval.

Pursuing a Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence with a specialization in Data Science. Relevant Coursework: AI/ML Deployment, Responsible AI, Model Development, Productionizing AI Applications.

I went to ASU and studied Computer Science. Relevant Coursework: Generative AI, Distributed Systems, Cloud Computing, Information Assurance and Security, Advanced Computer Network Security, Software Security, Computer and Network Forensics, Applied Cryptography, Data Processing at Scale, Digital Video Processing, Fundamentals of Statistical Learning and Pattern Recognition. Served as a teaching assistant for CSE 365 (Information Assurance) and CSE 543 (Information Assurance and Security) for two straight semesters. GPA: 4.07/4.00.

I went to JECRC and studied Computer Science and Engineering. Relevant Coursework: Data Structures, Advanced Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Distributed Software Development, Databases, Compilers, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture. GPA: 7.62/10.
